query: On average per year over 2012-2019, how many percentage points of Germany's growth in real income per person came from changes in the share of the population in work, as opposed to output per worker?

text.text: Identifies the decomposition of GDP-per-capita growth into labour productivity (GDP per worker) and the employment rate (employment per capita).
text.accept: full = log-difference decomposition into productivity and employment-to-population (working-age share lumped in employment rate acceptable)

data.text: Uses WEO series: NGDP_R, LE, LP.

computation.accept: full = within tolerance; employment-rate contribution = annualised dln(LE/LP)

assembled_from: San Marino 2023 Art IV (a507cd39, blocks 568-570), after Jaumotte et al. 2016
provenance.selection: seeded draw (20261030), distinct country within style where possible

gold_report_note: No corpus report states these values; gold is recomputed from the frozen WEO vintage by formula (formula-validated, no published figure).
distractors: Cobb-Douglas growth accounting with capital and TFP
